item.title: Annual Chocolate Lovers Feast held in Weston
item.description: Held inside the Museum of American Glass, the feast welcomes the community to taste chocolate in various forms, with each treat homemade by locals and friends of the museum.

item.title: West Virginians raise concerns about DHS funding and ICE actions
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security encompasses both Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP), two agencies that have come under intense criticism not just nationwide, but in north central West Virginia.

item.title: Coopers Rock Winterfest brings winter fun to West Virginia
item.description: Several international students from WVU made the trip as a part of Adventure WV & the Carruth Center's Well-being Adventure Series, a collaborative outdoor program designed to help students explore new interests and build meaningful connections with their peers.

item.title: West Virginia Senate introduces Cohen Craddock Student Athlete Safety Act
item.description: The Cohen Craddock Student Athlete Safety Act aims to protect student athletes in West Virginia by requiring soft-shelled helmet covers and concussion education.

item.title: West Virginia students shine in regional Science Bowl event
item.description: The Science Bowl is a national academic competition hosted by the U.S. Department of Energy that tests high school and middle school students on their knowledge across all areas of STEM, and winners from regional competitions will receive a fully funded trip to compete at the national competition in Washington, D.C.

item.title: Local pizzeria working to provide food before the big game
item.description: Washington Square Pizzeria and Lounge was working around the clock on Sunday to offer top quality pizza, wings, salad and more for those watching the Super Bowl.

item.title: Local figure skating club inspires youth in Morgantown
item.description: Offering group introductory skating lessons through their officially sanctioned Learn to Skate USA program, the club helps dozens of community members engage in the Olympic discipline each year, and it is the only officially sanctioned program in the Morgantown area.

item.title: Goat barn burns down in Harrison County
item.description: A goat barn burned to the ground in rural Harrison County on Friday.

item.title: Body found in Lumberport: Harrison County Sheriff's Office
item.description: The Harrison County 911 log shows that emergency crews responded to a welfare check at 8:45 a.m. on the same road, and then the sheriff's office returning to the road at around 7 p.m. Saturday evening for a "follow up".
